title: FleetRun
description: One Fleet meta-orchestrator run, persisted by the cockpit at apps/cockpit/server/data/fleet/<id>.json via atomicWriteJson and emitted (summarised) on the SSE fleet_update event. A goal fans out to N governed child sessions (each in its own git worktree/branch) and fans back in to one synthesis session. Permissive on purpose (additionalProperties:true, few required) so the shape can grow and so a future migration onto the Workflow engine does not break older persisted runs.

id.description: Filesystem-safe run id: slugify(goal) + ISO timestamp.

status.description: Derived run status. Canonical values: pending | running | partial | succeeded | failed | cancelled | budget_exceeded | orphaned. budget_exceeded means a running cost total crossed policy.budgetUsd and no further children were spawned (in-flight children were allowed to finish). orphaned is a TERMINAL state set by the boot reconciler (reconcileFleetRuns) when a server restart left a run in a non-terminal status whose live process/lifecycle is gone: the run can never settle itself, so it is honestly closed as orphaned rather than left wedged at 'running'. Kept a free string (not an enum) so the shape can grow without breaking validation.

spentUsd.description: Running total USD across ALL children that report a cost (workers + verifiers + synthesis), summed from each child.cost.totalCost (missing/null treated as 0). Recomputed on every cost movement.

budgetRemaining.description: max(0, policy.budgetUsd - spentUsd) when a budget is set, else null. Stored for the UI budget bar.

budgetUsd.description: Hard dollar cap for the whole run. When set, enables budget enforcement: refuse to spawn a child whose projected cost would exceed it, and stop spawning (run → budget_exceeded) once spentUsd crosses it. Omitted = no enforcement (count cap only).

perChildUsd.description: Optional per-child cost estimate used for the pre-spawn projection (since actual child.cost lags). Falls back to a conservative default when unset.

verify.description: Adversarial verification. true is sugar for { minApprovals:1, maxRounds:1 }. minApprovals = independent verifier approvals a worker needs; maxRounds = how many times a rejected worker may be re-dispatched (bounded loop-until-done). Omitted = off.

pid.description: OS process id of the spawned child, captured into the durable registry at spawn time so the boot reconciler can cross-check liveness (process.kill(pid, 0)) after a restart. Null until captured / when unknown.

status.description: Per-child status: starting | running | escalated | succeeded | failed | cancelled | verifying | rejected | budget_skipped | orphaned. verifying = a worker settled succeeded and a verifier is reviewing it. rejected = a verifier rejected it and re-dispatch is exhausted. budget_skipped = the child (worker or verifier) was never spawned because its projected cost would exceed the budget. orphaned = the child was non-terminal when a server restart killed its process; the boot reconciler reaped it to this terminal state.

childKind.description: Distinguishes workers from verifier children. Defaults to 'worker'. Verifier children are spawned through the same seam to adversarially review a worker's branch.

quarantine.description: When true, the child is given a best-effort read-only / no-privileged-action stance via a prompt directive (and the harness rails where present). NOT a sandbox — advisory only for projects without rails. A quarantined child is barred from being the synthesis/acting child.

verifiedBy.description: The verifier child sessionId/branch that produced the latest approve (for a UI link).

rounds.description: Re-dispatch count for this worker, bounded by policy.verify.maxRounds.

verdicts.description: One entry per verification round on this worker.

cost.description: Per-child cost in the cockpit's canonical session-cost shape (parsers/sessions.js estimatedCost, from utils/cost.js calculateCost). Populated from the child session's estimatedCost when the session id is known / settles. Null until then.
